title: Small molecule antagonists of PTPmu identified by artificial intelligence-based computational screening block glioma cell migration and growth.
summary: AtomNet selected previously untested candidates; cellular assays, a phosphatase assay and a mouse tumor experiment supported glioma-active hits. Preclinical findings do not establish clinical benefit.
organization: Case Western Reserve University; Numerion Labs (United States)

evidence.tested: AtomNet selected previously untested candidates; cellular assays, a phosphatase assay and a mouse tumor experiment supported glioma-active hits. Preclinical findings do not establish clinical benefit.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: AtomNet neural-network virtual screening is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
